verdict.rationale: Galileo captures every session, trace and span, offers session-level metrics, and tracks Cost as a metric (used in alert configurations), so attributing cost to sessions is plausible but only implied. No evidence shows custom metadata or tags for attributing cost or usage to users or features. Missing for 10: documented custom metadata/tagging on traces, per-user and per-feature cost attribution, explicit cost breakdown or grouping by session, and any independent corroboration.
